description: A sprite sheet of EIGHT separate home aquarium objects arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell, all aquariums EMPTY of fish. Top row: a small glass fish bowl with clear water and pebbles, a wooden-framed rectangular aquarium tank with water plants and sand, a large ornate golden-framed aquarium tank with coral and glowing light, a round stone garden fish pond with lily pads and clear water. Bottom row: a cluster of green aquarium water plants, a small pink coral decoration, a tiny sunken treasure chest decoration, a little stone castle aquarium ornament. Front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no fish, no animals, no characters, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
